contract: HOST-PORTS-V1-r1 接受 APP-V1-05／FEAT-V1-06 的 E 環境與 P 檔案選取配對。Capabilities 持有純環境解析及既有 KlpAppPlatform／KlpAdaptiveMode 唯一宣告，Stable foundation 原 facade、型別與 current(Size?) 行為保留；application 唯一既有 host 採樣並安裝，不增加 observer、store 或預設。P 接替已接受的 concrete picker 宣告式面：公開 L1 KlpPickFileAction，port/result 套件內部；application 唯一 plugin adapter，既有 action handler 用原 frame/lease/epoch/entry 在 await 前後檢驗。有效 selected 才回呼一次，cancel/stale/failed 為 false，平台或 callback error 原物件／stack 由 host 一次回報。舊零 host picker 搬 application/legacy 並由專用 legacy root 保留 const/欄位/pick Future 成功取消與原 error 傳播；不作現行宿主 fallback。公開 roots 6→7，僅 declarative 一增一刪及新 legacy，feature exports 67→66，24 components/28 IDs/順序保持。原 R1/APP06 root/hash/closure/catalog 基準依 path-map 精確增減由獨立作者更新，不 blanket resnapshot 或放寬原守衛。E 單獨不完成 APP05；E/P 與完整證據通過才 APP05/FEAT06 complete。

api.environment_canonical: KlpEnvironmentSnapshot: const value fields platform, deviceClass=desktop, orientation=landscape, displayMode=browser, adaptiveMode='', required isWebRuntime. factory resolve({required KlpAppPlatform platform, required bool isWebRuntime, double? width, double? height, Map<String,String> queryParameters=const {}}); getters effectiveAdaptiveMode/isAndroid/isWindows/isDesktop/isMobile/isTablet. Package-internal, no root export.
api.environment_adapter: Private application library part _KlpApplicationEnvironmentObserver: const constructor; KlpEnvironmentSnapshot observe({Size? viewportSize}); KlpApplicationEnvironment environment(KlpEnvironmentSnapshot snapshot) projects original private platform/accessibility/motion constructor and dispatcher flags. One host-owned instance, no additional observer or stream. _accept uses observe with original optional size, build builder calls observe with original MediaQuery size and reuses snapshot for viewport + environment.
api.stable_facade: Original KlpPlatformInfo class/const constructor/fields/getters/factory current({Size? viewportSize}) retained; samples globals only and delegates pure resolver/getters. Retain runtime !kIsWeb dependence in manually constructed getters.
api.moved_types: KlpAppPlatform is enum with original values/order. KlpAdaptiveMode is abstract final class, not enum. Both original paths reexport exact moved type via show. Existing device/orientation/display enums readonly.
api.public_action: final class KlpPickFileAction implements KlpAction { final List<String> acceptedExtensions; final void Function(String path) onPicked; const KlpPickFileAction({this.acceptedExtensions=const [], required this.onPicked}); } No pick(), host, port or dispatch API.
api.private_port: KlpFileSelectionPort.select(KlpFileSelectionRequest request) -> Future<KlpFileSelectionResult>; immutable request extensions snapshot; sealed result: KlpFileSelected(String path), KlpFileSelectionCancelled(), KlpFileSelectionFailed(Object error, StackTrace stackTrace).
api.application_adapter: const KlpFileSelectionAdapter implements KlpFileSelectionPort; sole file_selector import. Original group label assets, empty groups unrestricted, path unchanged, original error/stack -> failure.
api.session: Required internal final KlpFileSelectionPort fileSelection constructor parameter on _KlpApplicationSession, supplied by host. No public KlpApplication/runKlpApp signature change.
api.legacy: Original final KlpLocalFilePicker const constructor/fields/defaults/Future<void> pick() now application/legacy; show export only from dedicated new public legacy root. Per-call stateless adapter; success callback once/cancel none/failed Error.throwWithStackTrace; callback errors naturally propagate, never double-report via host.

environment_rules: Preserve original no-viewport _accept on init/source updates; postframe/metrics use first dispatcher view logical size; no views or zero ratio -> null; build uses MediaQuery maybe size. No cached replacement for null and no cross-event query cache.

Native mobile shortestSide >=600 tablet; native desktop remains desktop. Native nativeApp display and ignore query. Valid width/height >0; square landscape; preserve NaN fallback and no new validation.

Web mode.trim nonempty wins simulate. Mode case-sensitive contains tablet before phone/mobile, unknown still forced and prevents size override. simulate lowerCase trim maps ipad/tablet or iphone/mobile/phone only, and valid sizes override simulate. Display only exact standalone. Size never overrides forced mode device, but always resolves orientation.

Web shortestSide <600 phone; [600,1024) tablet; >=1024 desktop. Missing/invalid dimensions preserve initial landscape/default or simulation. Native Android/iOS defaults phone, others desktop. Fuchsia other.
Manual facade adaptiveMode whitespace remains nonempty, isDesktop/isMobile preserve !kIsWeb runtime predicate. Capability owns all inference; Stable does only native-framework mapping and sampling.

Accessibility disableAnimations -> immediate else reduceMotion -> reduced else standard; original private application constructors and public enum identities unchanged. Accessibility rebuild does not reinstall resources.

lease_policy.activation: Existing workspace materialize derived lease.runAsync guards initial hidden/stale placement. Handler locally captures exact action (including callback), request snapshot, session.frame, frame.lease, session._epoch and machine.state.value.current.id before await. Reject before picker if frame null, lease inactive, session disposed/terminal/projecting, epoch null/uncommitted; no public lease injection.
lease_policy.delivery: Before selected callback require same captured frame and epoch as session current, captured lease.isActive, epoch.committed, same active entry id, session not disposed/terminal. Never reread action/callback from a newer frame. Pending style commit replacing frame/epoch suppresses old successful delivery even if placement ID is unchanged.
lease_policy.identity: Retain each original action object in its activation closure. No lookup by placement alone, no mutable handler.currentAction slot, no global action map. Reusing same public action object across a new frame does not preserve old lease eligibility.
lease_policy.error: Platform failed reports original error/stack once even when stale. Callback invoked only while valid; callback throw reports once. Semantic handler returns false for error/cancel/stale, true after successful callback. Legacy path rethrows and never host-reports.
lease_policy.concurrency: One request per valid activation, no queue/dedupe. Capture independently; callback source update can invalidate remaining in-flight results. Host dispose invalidates delivery, cannot promise OS dialog cancellation.
